Subject: Dedicated capacity recap / next steps (Acme Health)

Hi Sanjay 


Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I pull together a formal proposal: 

Summary of needs / pain points you mentioned:
- Predictable latency for inference across peak windows (current spikes affecting triage flows).
- Data isolation / HIPAA controls — no multi-tenant model serving for PHI.
- Deterministic scaling during business hours with headroom for unexpected surges.
- Auditability: request/response logs, key management, and SOC2 evidence for vendor assessment.

Proposed dedicated capacity (initial recommendation):
- Reserved cluster: 4 x A100 GPUs (dedicated to Acme Health) in us-west region.
- Autoscale policy: burst to 8 GPUs for sustained traffic > 75% utilization over 10 minutes.
- Network/NAS: VPC-only access with customer-managed subnet and strict egress rules.
- SLA targets: 99.95% uptime; p95 latency target <200ms for standard generation use-cases (we'll validate with your sample workload).

Operational notes:
- We can deploy a private tenant with customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest.
- Prefix/KV caching and batching configuration will be tuned post-demo to hit latency and cost targets.

Next steps I recommend:
1) I’ll send a formal proposal + SOW (attached) with pricing ranges based on the 4->8 GPU model.
2) You share the procurement timeline & PO process (Priya / procurement contacts).
3) Security questionnaire: we’ll attach SOC2 and encryption docs; we can schedule a technical review with our security engineer.
4) Follow-up call: Can we do Thu 5/7 at 9am PT to review the proposal?

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_v1.pdf, Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SOW-Acme-Redwood-2026.docx

Happy to adjust any of the above • flagged items for you to confirm are isolation level and autoscale headroom.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme-health.com>

Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity recap / next steps (Acme Health)

Marissa •

Thanks for the clear write-up. Looks aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Isolation: we require a single-tenant deployment for any environment that processes PHI. Can you confirm the reserved cluster model you proposed is single-tenant (not shared with other Redwood customers)?
2) SLA: the uptime target is fine. For latency, our internal bar is p95 < 150ms for short prompt families — is p95 <200ms achievable after tuning? Can we schedule an initial benchmarking run against a 1k sample of our prompts?
3) Security: please include SOC2 Type II report and details on customer-managed KMS. Priya will own the questionnaire.
4) Procurement timeline: we’d like to close procurement by end of May if pricing is in the expected range. Do you have ballpark monthly committed cost for the 4-A100 reserved config vs 8-A100 burst?

If you can confirm the above and send the proposal, I’ll loop in our engineering and procurement folks. Thu 5/7 9am PT works for the review.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of AI Infrastructure | Acme Health
sanjay@acme-health.com

Thanks Sanjay • appreciate the detail. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

Isolation: Confirmed. The reserved cluster model we propose is single-tenant: the physical GPUs and serving runtime are dedicated to Acme Health. We will not colocate other customers on those nodes; network and tenant isolation are enforced at the orchestration layer.

Latency / benchmarking: p95 <150ms is an aggressive target but achievable for many short prompt families once we tune batching, KV cache settings, and kernel selection. Proposed approach:
- Step 1: we run a 1k-prompt benchmarking pass on a staging dataset (you can mask PHI).
- Step 2: we iterate on runtime config (batch size, prefix cache) and re-run.
- Step 3: we'll provide a results brief and recommended config for production.

Ballpark pricing (monthly committed):
- 4 x A100 reserved (single-tenant): $75k/mo (includes managed runtime, monitoring, and support)
- Burst to 8 x A100 (autoscale): additional $35k/mo for reserved headroom; actual burst usage billed at usage rates.
- We can provide an enterprise discount and commit terms in the SOW.

Attachments: proposal & SOW are attached. I’ve also included our security overview (SOC2 excerpts + KMS integration guide).

Next steps we’ll execute this week:
1) I’ll upload the formal proposal & SOW to DocuSign (link below).
2) Security team will send SOC2 Type II and relevant artifacts to Priya.
3) Schedule the benchmarking run — can your infra team share a masked sample dataset and a contact for the run?
4) Thu 5/7 9am PT — meeting invite (sent).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/ACME-REDWOOD-PROP-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.redwood.com/hubspot/deal/DEAL-ACME-2026-04

Let me know if you want me to adjust the reserved sizes (we can start at 2 GPUs and scale to 4 if you prefer a lower ramp).

Best,
Marissa
